bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (player.rs, mod.rs VideoDecoder trait, hwdec/, demux/, symfile.rs), springboard/audiod, springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (Player view)
summary: Media Toolbox covers the audio processing tap API (MTAudioProcessingTap*), registration of professional video format readers, and localized media type names. BifrOSt has no public Media Toolbox equivalent: decoding, demuxing and playback run inside the shell's media module and are not exposed to apps, and there is no audio tap hook in audiod.

features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (audio_process.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. The pure model had no caller and was removed. No API lets an app inspect or process audio from a playing mix. The ALSA mixer in audio/alsa/src/ctl.rs sets volume controls and is not a tap.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 5 (w5-media-toolbox, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Demuxers are fixed in code (mp4, webm, symphonia-based readers). No runtime registration point exists.

features.apple: No public Media Toolbox counterpart (decoding is internal to the framework)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mod.rs (VideoDecoder trait, default_decoder), springboard/src/media/hwdec/mod.rs, hwdec/ffmpeg.rs, hwdec/vaapi.rs
features.note: Hardware decode through libavcodec and VA-API with a software fallback. Used by the player and the wowstream video code, not exposed as an SDK API.

features.apple: No direct Media Toolbox counterpart (playback goes through AVFoundation and Core Media)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/av_player.rs (player item, rate, seek, time observers); springboard/ui/src/av_queue_player.rs; springboard/sdk/src/audio_player_control.rs (pan, rate, timed fade); springboard/src/media/player.rs (Player::open_with, open_parts), springboard/src/media/audioplayer.rs, springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (Player view, line 842)
features.note: The playback model (items, rate, seeking, observers, queue) is tested headless in ui/tests/av_playback.rs, driven by a caller clock and silent until play. Gap: the shell's decoder and audio output do not run it, so an app cannot start sound through the SDK and the Player view stays a drawing control.

features.feature: Localized media type and subtype names
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 5 (w5-media-toolbox, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Codec kinds exist as an enum, but no localized display names are produced. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: Audio processing tap: no API to read or process audio from the playing mix (MTAudioProcessingTap family), and no tap point in springboard/audiod.
Format reader registration: demuxers are compiled in; no runtime registration for professional video workflow readers.
Localized media type and subtype names are not provided for apps.
Decoding and playback exist only inside the shell's media module; no SDK API lets apps drive decoding or playback directly.
